# Odin documents

`learn.odn`, `plot.odn` and `version.odn` are copied from the `etc/` folder of the Odin repository
(<https://gitlab.com/next-tools/odin>, Matt Davies): real documents saved by Odin's editor. They are the oracle of the
`odin` codec: decoding and encoding gives the same bytes, and the text of the first lines is what Odin shows.
